independence_declaration.statement: I am qa-verifier. I didn't author any analysis, register, agent definition, runner, guard, gate tooling, CI or delivery record in the reviewed scope. I wrote only QA tests and evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/ and my own round-19 review files. I read no other round-19 review record. Disclosure: at 09:35Z HEAD had moved to another reviewer's metadata-only auto-commit. My `validate.mjs --reconcile` in a fresh HEAD clone (log 14) printed a one-line status of another round-19 record. By then I had already formed my verdict from QA19-P4 (log 12, 09:32Z). I didn't open that record, and it didn't influence this review.

checks_run.procedure: D-033: run the process-sandbox suite, including the F-DG0-152 positive control, directly (not nested in a PID namespace), so the cross-run sub-checks actually execute rather than skip
checks_run.environment: clone at 0a65201; this run's shell (Landlock ABI 7 on this kernel)
checks_run.expected: 10/10 pass. The F-DG0-152 case runs fully: without Landlock the cross-run writes and signal succeed, with Landlock they are refused, own areas stay writable and nested bwrap works
checks_run.actual: 10/10 pass, 0 skipped. Diagnostics: without Landlock {viaProcRoot:WROTE, viaProcCwd:WROTE, viaProcRootTmp:WROTE, signal:allowed, nested:works}. With Landlock {viaProcRoot:refused, viaProcCwd:refused, viaProcRootTmp:refused, ownEvidence:WROTE, ownTmp:WROTE, signal:refused, nested:works}. So the new skip path in 0a65201 wasn't taken here, and the control really ran.

checks_run.procedure: Step 2 (A24/A25): independent round-19 suite. G0 control; G1 re-runs my 94-case round-9 A24/A25 suite (missing reviewer, author-reviewer, shared invocation, failed/blocked check, unresolved High, incomplete requirement, non-existent anchor, SOURCE row without block, coverage gaps, change after freeze, tampered manifest, metadata invariance) on a fixture reshaped to the D-030/D-033 evidence rules. New cases not in tools/gates/tests: L1 (6 Landlock record variants), P1/P2/P3/P4 (D-035), W1 (D-034 delete + re-add), I1 (import-findings record-less sidecar), M1 (metadata invariance on the real candidate)
checks_run.environment: disposable fixture git repos under $TMPDIR; validator code from the clone at 0a65201; node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: every invalid fixture rejected; controls clean; metadata doesn't change the candidate; content edits do
checks_run.actual: 9/10 pass. G0 control: 0 errors. G1: 94 cases. The only failures are the expected ones: 3 cwd-binding controls, the superseded QA7-N83, and QA5-N57, which now fails by design of D-035 because a pruned-commit round is accepted. L1: all 6 Landlock variants rejected (handled_access_net=1, scoped without SIGNAL, per_run_domain 'true', landlock:true, handled_access_fs '0', scoped as a string). P1 rejected (via fix_revision). P2: a reachable but mismatched commit is still rejected. P3: a tree id as source_commit recomputes fine; same on the pre-D-035 code, so harmless. W1: delete + same-blob re-add and delete + different-blob re-add are both rejected by checkWriteOnce. I1: the record-less sidecar is skipped (finding stays pending, sidecar kept), and it is imported once the record exists. M1: metadata keeps 6720ad2c, a glossary edit changes it. FAIL: P4. A current-mode APPROVED gate whose source_commit doesn't exist validates with 0 errors (F-DG0-240).

checks_run.procedure: D-035 assessment: run P1-P4 against the candidate and against 695ab30 (before D-035) to isolate the behaviour change
checks_run.command: for R in cand pre035; do QA_REPO_ROOT=$TMPDIR/r19/$R node --test --test-name-pattern='QA19-P' docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/tests/dg0-gate-negative-r19.test.mjs; done
checks_run.expected: D-035 loosens only non-gate rounds; the gate's own commit stays checked in the mode used at approval
checks_run.actual: P4 current mode: 0 errors on 0a65201, 2 errors on 695ab30 ('round 1/2 manifest ... cannot recompute from its source_commit'). Historical mode rejects on both. In current mode, checkCandidate recomputes from the working tree, not from gate.source_commit, so D-035's claim holds only for --historical. For superseded non-gate rounds, the loosening is acceptable: self-consistency, round-record equality, and mismatch on a reachable commit (P2) are all still enforced. Finding F-DG0-240, Medium.

summary: FAIL for DG0 candidate 6720ad2c (0a65201), because of one Medium finding: F-DG0-240. D-035's pruned-commit tolerance also applies to the gate's own round, so current-mode validation accepts an APPROVED gate whose source_commit doesn't exist. Before D-035 that was rejected; --historical still rejects it. Everything else passes: all required commands, prefreeze (11/11), the F-DG0-152 positive control run fully, the A24/A25 regression suite, 6 new Landlock negatives, the D-034 history and import-findings checks, register integrity, the agent load evidence, the live guard probe and feasibility. F-DG0-236, 237 and 239 are verified fixed.
